clips.title: The story
paras: At the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, Glorin Steelbrow aids Bishop Farthing's work from afar. He helps travelers search the Wetlands coast for sacred relics and materials lost with the Third Fleet, linking Duskwood's troubles to the northern shipwrecks.

From Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Bishop Farthing aids the people of Duskwood against its creeping terrors. Far to the north, he keeps ties in Menethil Harbor through Glorin Steelbrow, who works inside the Deepwater Tavern. Glorin offers aid and direction to travelers sent north for sacred metals and forgotten relics. His work connects the troubled forest in the south with the sunken wreckage off the Wetlands coast.
